data.title: 一色彩羽 · 圣诞晚会后台的微醺红晕·「前辈……今晚可不可以只当我的圣诞老人呢」
data.description: 【联合圣诞晚会礼堂后台·雪夜】大获成功的圣诞活动幕后。彩羽头戴小红帽发箍，身上披着红色天鹅绒小斗篷，怀里抱着给你的特制礼物盒。在彩灯与幕布之间，她难得收起了小恶魔面具，眼中泛起真诚温润的水光，通红着脸将礼物递到你的怀里。
data.location: 礼堂后台幕布与彩灯旁
data.action: 手抱礼品盒微仰，红帽发箍披红色斗篷，真情告白泛红眼眸
data.lighting: 后台彩灯串五彩斑斓光芒与雪夜窗外幽蓝
data.camera: medium shot, christmas cape, holding gift box, backstage lights, sincere blush
data.promptProse: Iroha Isshiki stands in the quiet backstage wings of the school auditorium during a snowy Christmas eve event, illuminated by strings of colorful fairy lights. She wears a festive white-trimmed red velvet capelet over her uniform, holding a neatly wrapped gift box against her chest. Shedding every trace of her manipulative teasing, her hazel eyes well with genuine, heartfelt warmth and bashful tears, her cheeks glowing crimson as she offers the present with a trembling, tender smile. Medium shot, magical holiday bokeh, detailed backstage background, solo 1girl, no text.
